_comment: Default copy for the CBAT outcome questionnaire email.
JSON, and in constants/ rather than beside the mailer, so the admin editor can import the
exact same strings the sender falls back to - same arrangement as categories.json. A
placeholder shown in the Admin > Content form that differed from what actually goes out
would be worse than showing nothing.
An empty setting in AppSettings means 'use these'. Placeholders: {{name}} is the
recipient's display name, {{button}} is where the link button lands, {{link}} is the raw
URL. The unsubscribe line is appended to the footer by the sender and is deliberately not
editable here - it must not be possible to remove it by editing the copy.
subject: How did your CBAT go?
heading: How did it go?
subtitle: {{name}}, six questions and about a minute.
body:
Hello {{name}},

You trained with SkyWatch for a while, and then things went quiet. That usually means one thing: you have sat the real test.

If that is you, would you tell us how it went?

- Your answers go straight back into the training, so whoever is revising right now gets a better version than you had. What matched, what did not, and what we should fix.
- If you passed, we will record it. A PASSED badge then appears beside your name on every leaderboard.
- Six questions, about a minute, nothing to sign in to. The link below is yours alone.

{{button}}

Not sat it yet? Say so on the first question and we will leave you alone until after your test. Good luck with it.

Thanks,
The SkyWatch Team
